CSS Transitions"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Transitions allow you to define how property changes should occur over a given duration. Tailwind lets you control transition properties, durations, timing functions, and delays effortlessly."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"transition-all: Applies transition effects to all transitionable properties."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"duration-300: Sets the transition duration to 300 milliseconds."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"ease-in-out: Applies a smooth acceleration and deceleration curve."},{"order":8,"type":"code","text":""},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"2. CSS Transforms"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"Transforms let you scale, rotate, translate, and skew elements.
